pairs.why: A keeps the quiet pink wave backdrop and a plain tile ledge with the pool as a simple band, as in the real card, while B adds an invented splash and water-filled slide with a curved ledge and a busier pool surface.
Both place the same rope on the same tone-on-tone purple wave field, so staging and detail give no reason to choose.
B puts the helmet on a plain flat ledge against a flat field like the real shoes card, while A's glossy reflective slab and sphere-like staging add a surface the real cards don't have.

B's narrower, softer tone-on-tone stripes and small ceiling corner sit closer to the real wall, while A's wide high-contrast stripes pull more attention, though both add crown molding and light patches.
Both show the same beach with sea band and clouds at similar load, and neither is clearly quieter or busier than the real card.
B's larger, sparser tone-on-tone pi glyphs match the real quiet backdrop, while A's pi are smaller and darker with a bright glow behind the hero, so they read busier.
A has a plain orange gradient with a soft floor shadow like the real card, while B adds a visible horizon and floor reflection and makes the hero small.
A crops a large truss across the top like the real card and keeps the hero as one clean shape, while B shrinks the truss into a floating prop and adds yellow bolts, vents and extra small parts.
